blocks.title: readme-forge

blocks.text: A Claude skill that writes READMEs from your code, then checks every command, env var and path in them against the repo.

blocks.title: Why
blocks.subtitle: a README that guesses is worse than none

items.title: verify_readme.py
items.subtitle: every claim, checked against the repo
items.description: Extracts every command, script, flag, env var and path from a README and checks each one against the repository.

items.title: /readme-forge
items.subtitle: Claude Code, claude.ai, Desktop
items.description: Reads the repo first and writes only what it can point to in a file.

items.title: GitHub Action
items.subtitle: one PR comment
items.description: Scores and fact-checks READMEs on pull requests and can fail below a minimum score.

blocks.text:
```bash
claude plugin install readme-forge --marketplace tanmayai23/README-Editor-skill
```

Then, in Claude Code: `/readme-forge write a README for this repo`.
